modules.module_title: Identify the target area and audience

pcs.pc_description: identify the target area and audience by gathering information through different sources such as news media, the internet, industry members, etc.
evaluate the socio-economic aspects and agro-climatic conditions of the target area
identify the representative group of farmers and other stakeholders in the area such as the sarpanch, producer organisations, etc.
conduct meetings with the representative group of farmers and other stakeholders to assess their needs and explain the objectives and benefits of extension services
determine the suitability of any new technology in the local context through consultation with the representative group

modules.module_title: Plan the delivery of extension services

pcs.pc_description: prepare for providing extension services by taking training or seeking required clarifications regarding new technologies, tools, implements and equipment from the relevant Subject Matter Experts (SMEs)
plan the delivery of agriculture extension services through discussion with senior extension officers, taking inputs on the technology training requirements in the target area
arrange the necessary infrastructure, tools, implements, equipment, audio-visual aids and literature for conducting demonstrations and training sessions
prepare the training program shortlisting the technologies, tools, implements and equipment and activities to be explained and demonstrated such as soil-testing, field preparation, etc.
identify the problems to be addressed on the basis of priority, including applicable factors to be considered in on-farm experiments
select the appropriate mode for the delivery of training along with the time and venue of the training, etc.
prepare a cost-effective plan for providing agricultural extension services, considering the budget
prepare to disseminate information about the crop contingency plan developed for the region, along with the relevant existing and proposed government schemes and policies

modules.module_title: Prepare for field visits and demonstrations

pcs.pc_description: select the appropriate and proven technologies to be demonstrated
select an appropriate site for demonstrations, ensuring adequate space and safety of all the people involved
select a group of farmers as volunteers to participate in demonstrations
schedule field-visits and demonstrations to explain the use of relevant technologies, tools, implements, equipment, etc.

prepare the Package of Practices (PoP) for the implementation of relevant technologies in coordination with the relevant agricultural universities, government’s agriculture department, research institutes, SMEs, etc.
prepare relevant presentations for demonstrations, including all the important information

conduct field visits to demonstrate various agricultural activities and processes such as seeding, application of fertilisers/ insecticides/ pesticides, weeding, irrigation/ fertigation, harvesting, post-harvest processing, etc.

carry out demonstrations explaining the operation of various farm machineries and equipment, such as mechanical ploughing machine, harrow, rotavator, seed drill, plant protection equipment, harvesting equipment, etc.
conduct on-farm experiments using statistically valid experimental designs, ensuring the participation of farmers
determine the causes of problems and cause- effect relationships, along with possible solutions and their feasibility
assess the performance and potential application of the new technology or farm practices in the local context, determining any refinements or modifications required

maintain manual and/ or electronic record of all demonstrations, results of on-farm experiments using the physical registers and/ or the relevant computer application, ensuring to record all the relevant information
analyse the farm experiment results and deliberate upon the relevant ideas with the farmer representative group and stakeholders
maintain the record of deliberation held with the farmer representative group and stakeholders
use the experiment findings for improving training programs, demonstrations, and future research
prepare the technical report containing information on cost-benefit ratio with respect to the demonstration to determine the economic returns
prepare an economically and operationally viable action plan that meets the needs of the farmers
optimise the usage of water, electricity and other resources in various tasks and processes and encourage the farmers to do the same
connect the electrical equipment safely and disconnect them when not in use, advising the farmers to follow the same practice
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage and advise farmers to do the same
segregate waste into appropriate categories and explain the process to farmers
dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner and recycle the recyclable waste appropriately, encouraging the farmers to do the same

modules.module_title: Assist in establishing forward and backward linkages

assist the farmers in availing farmer-centric credit facilities along with personal and crop insurance etc.
